note: The input header selects RLE indexed TGA decoding with a one-pixel image and a 256-entry RGB palette.
The input-controlled header is passed into the image decoding routine after seeking past the header.
The 8-bit indexed pixel size becomes one byte per decoded RLE pixel.
The candidate provides the full palette, so decoding advances to the RLE packet stream with palette storage initialized.
The raw RLE packet header byte 0x00 makes the decoder request one indexed pixel byte.
The return value is ignored for raw RLE packets; the candidate omits the indexed pixel byte, so the heap image buffer byte remains uninitialized while the decoder treats it as filled.
The uninitialized heap image byte is loaded as the palette index.

code: scanline[x] = qRgb(palette[3 * idx + 2], palette[3 * idx + 1], palette[3 * idx + 0]);
note: The uninitialized index controls palette array addressing during RGB conversion, which is the target uninitialized-memory use.
